title: Research: legal H6 compensation networks and cost screen (no new kappa)
body:
**Current-main revision:** integration with `67b122d33d6c599a49f65d50afa2f3fe8d790d02` preserves the original scientific pins and artifacts. The live selected record gained proof-supplement metadata, so the CI wrapper now reads only that historical price benchmark from its already pinned Git object and verifies its unchanged digest in the private export. All other 89 input pins remain strict against the checkout. The workflow separately verifies the live selected record, and six regression controls cover the boundary. The wrapper records both benchmark digests; it does not rewrite either input or reprice the result.

The H6 proposal gives a conditional helper budget but leaves compensation loading, frame chronology and dirty restoration open. This PR supplies a finite local word and its cost screen: complete compressed edge and address-bucket networks with legal `[1,15,1]` helper paths, arbitrary logical dirt restoration in both orientations, and an explicit 816-center K encoder. The bucket word uses **227,312,640 helpers**, exceeding the largest allowance among tested L3/5/7 profiles (**94,434 at L5**). No new kappa or supplier admission is claimed.

This continues the [H6 exchange in Discussion 1167](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1167#discussioncomment-18914564) and [DreamingOfClouds's pinned script publication](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1167#discussioncomment-18914905). It includes the independent budget/Walsh audit and its construction successor. The [finding and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1167#discussioncomment-18923267) are posted in the originating H6 thread. [PR1698](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1698) independently overlaps the arithmetic; this adds exhaustive structural evidence, explicit legal words, exact frame recipes, coefficient streams and actual profile pricing. Research files stay in the three H6 directories, with one dedicated H6 CI workflow. Imported predecessors, PR606 inputs, upstream and the selected record are preserved.

**Evidence and replay:** readable summaries reference lossless compressed matrices, witnesses and fixtures by canonical decompressed JSON hashes, following `CONTRIBUTING.md`. All eight migrated payloads are unchanged from the originally submitted head. The package checks all 665,856 polynomial coefficients and 25,263,360 feature entries, finite all-column words, representative physical recipes, and exact rational invoices. Twelve optimized replay steps and the fresh-export mutation gate pass. The dedicated H6 workflow uses Python 3.12, pinned NumPy and full Git history, and runs the package in a disposable export to keep checked-out evidence unchanged. Its entry point passed locally in a real Linux container, and the [dedicated hosted H6 job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38563166103/job/115849082010) subsequently passed for synthetic merge `f7babf9b0057f88271447b99bc05a5204ee0a1c9` of reviewed head `a6578b3d` into original base `0b1cccf8`. The wider repository workflow has separate inherited failures and cancellations; no whole-repository CI pass or hosted pass on a later revision is claimed.

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/h6-compensation-network/ci.py
python3 -I -B research/h6-compensation-network/test_ci.py
make selected-record-check
```

Revision `ef03620dff68d5be924b338f40c5c310e9359557` passes the complete local H6 gate, six benchmark-boundary regressions and live selected-record integrity. Hosted CI on this revision remains separate. Use Python 3.12 with NumPy 2.3.5 and full Git history. Exact pins, receipts, credit and **Open next questions** are in [the report](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ef03620dff68d5be924b338f40c5c310e9359557/research/h6-compensation-network/README.md) and [validation scope](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ef03620dff68d5be924b338f40c5c310e9359557/research/h6-compensation-network/VALIDATION.md).

**Open:** the billion-event full word is not executed, and immutable bank/controller/pad/tape integration, approximate-child precision, all-size bit supply and analytic transfer remain unadmitted. The 60/27-bit grid bounds assume exact local children. Partial mask routes cannot compose with K for free; fixed-architecture exclusions do not lower-bound arbitrary mixed circuits.

Credit Dominik Scholz/PR606, DreamingOfClouds/H6/PR1590, Andrey Mas/PR1698 and the selected/pending lineage. Prepared for Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and ten specialist agents. Apache-2.0; no independent human or full-theorem verification claim.
